title: Thewalai Khanet, Ganesha Shrine

sources.facts: The survey identifies a high platform, domed concrete roof with Lopburi influence and brass ornaments. The enshrined figure faces toward Bhimarn Prathom.
The palace guardian shrine stands on the lawn in front of Bhimarn Prathom and houses the Ganesha figure.
The historic audience axis aligns the central shrine with Bhimarn Prathom and Phra Pathom Chedi.
Primary historical research identifies the enshrined figure as cast bronze and records the 1919 consecration.

notes: Reviewed all of the palace story’s Qualla imagery first. Its dedicated Ganesh memorial photograph requires attribution and falls outside this public-domain-only batch. The exact mapped footprint and primary architectural and historical texts guide the shrine and original simplified figure.
